title: Assets Library
description: Import local files through the backend and link them to project entities.

hints.title: Usage hints enabled
hints.description: Project settings are surfacing real asset usages so you can see where a file is already reused.

usage.title: Project usage
usage.loadingDescription: The asset is being matched against characters and generation outputs.

detachDialog.title: Detach link?
detachDialog.description: Removing this link from {{assetName}} will not delete the file or touch real project usage.
detachDialog.note: The file stays in the library. Only this explicit project link is removed.

deleteDialog.title: Remove asset?
deleteDialog.archiveDescription: Removing {{name}} will archive it instead of hard-deleting the file.
deleteDialog.hardDeleteDescription: Removing {{name}} will permanently delete the file and unlink it from the project.
deleteDialog.checkingUsages: Checking where this asset is used before continuing.
deleteDialog.noUsages: No usages are currently tracked for this asset.

empty.title: No asset
